title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type “more on G3” (or any code) in April’s chat, or tap More info on this page and paste the request there, and I’ll dig in.

items.headline_md: **Paraguay**’s president **Santiago Peña** resigns over the **Ueno Bank** collapse
items.summary_md: Peña announced his resignation Thursday as lawmakers debated impeachment; the central bank started resolution proceedings for the digital lender Tuesday after its solvency ratio fell below half the required minimum.

items.headline_md: **France** protests: about **600,000** march, **400+** arrests
items.summary_md: The Interior Ministry estimate was about 600,000 marchers (the CGT union said ~1.6 million); authorities reported over 400 arrests and more than 50 injured police officers.

items.headline_md: Update: **Europe** bomb-threat wave now **18+** flights
items.summary_md: At least 18 passenger flights reported threats, with emergency landings, diversions and military escorts (yesterday’s count was 14+).

items.headline_md: Update: **IRGC** says it shot down two **US** drones over **Qeshm Island**
items.summary_md: Iran’s state news agency IRNA reported the claim, which has not been independently verified in the sources read.

items.headline_md: **Israel**: **Eisenkot** leads Netanyahu in recommendations to form the next government
items.summary_md: Yashar’s chair Gadi Eisenkot received 67 recommendations to Netanyahu’s 46, and the party urged President Herzog to hand him the mandate.

sections.title: Business
sections.body_md: The October jobs report lands at 6:30 AM AZ today, so its result isn’t in this brief.

items.headline_md: **NYT Company** in exclusive talks to buy **Letterboxd** for ~**$330M**
items.summary_md: No deal is signed and talks could still fall apart; Letterboxd has about 30 million users and A24 reportedly dropped out as the price rose.

items.headline_md: **Axon** puts **$1.2B** more into **Skydio**; stock **−14%** after hours
items.summary_md: Axon becomes Skydio’s exclusive US and Canada distributor but missed Q3 profit estimates ($1.72 vs $1.88 EPS) and trimmed its 2026 growth outlook to about 30%.

items.headline_md: Jobs report preview: economists expect **+59K** jobs, unemployment **4.2%**
items.summary_md: September was +29K; payroll growth from January 2025 through September 2026 averaged only 35K a month.

items.headline_md: Traders see a **68%** chance the **Fed** raises rates in December
items.summary_md: That’s per CME FedWatch, cited Friday as higher oil fed inflation worries.

items.headline_md: **Musk**’s paper wealth down **$113B** in two days as **Tesla** and **SpaceX** sink
items.summary_md: Tesla fell 3.34% Wednesday and 10.7% Thursday; SpaceX fell 3.8% then 9%, per Bloomberg’s Billionaires Index.

items.headline_md: **Sony** games profit **+83%**; **Wolverine** sells **2.4M**, **PS5** shipments fall
items.summary_md: Game & Network Services operating profit was about ¥220B ($1.3B); PS5 sold 2.6M units versus 4M a year ago, and Sony raised its full-year games profit forecast to ¥700B.

items.headline_md: Update: **Nintendo** says no further **Switch 2** price hike planned
items.summary_md: Furukawa said Nintendo can secure enough memory; Switch 2 sales fell 37.4% year over year after the earlier $50 increase to $499.

items.headline_md: **Unity** posts its first profit since IPO as **Vector** ads grow **126%**
items.summary_md: Q3 revenue was $622M (+32%) with $122M GAAP net income, and Unity guided Q4 strategic revenue up 65–67%; the ironSource Ads network is shut down.

items.headline_md: **GTA VI** launches Nov 19 on **PS5** and **Xbox**, **$79.99**
items.summary_md: A PC version has no date yet; the retail box holds only a download code.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: **Wii U lifter watch:** no confirmed public repo or release from the r/decomps Wii U lifter (u/Mindstormman) turned up today. Search only found small unrelated repos such as [nWiiURecomp](https://github.com/BlackLineInteractive/nWiiURecomp) (0 stars), which I can’t tie to that project. Reddit’s RSS feeds returned a redirect, so r/decomps and r/emulation weren’t read directly; worth a browser check. No new verified news today on LAS Recomp, Kirikae or a RE4 GameCube PC port.

items.headline_md: **Lichii** forks boot the **Switch 2** *Ocarina of Time* remake on PC
items.summary_md: It’s far from playable: the open world has flashing artifacts, though the Great Deku Tree ran about 40–60 FPS on high-end rigs, and the official Lichii build may not run it yet, so be careful with random forks.

items.headline_md: **EglantinePS5** brings experimental **Switch 2** emulation to jailbroken **PS5**
items.summary_md: It’s an early alpha with video, audio, input and saves working; reports say *Pokémon Pokopia* works while *Mario Kart World* is mixed, and it needs firmware 13.60 or older.

items.headline_md: **Hydroid** runs 64-bit **Android** games natively on jailbroken **PS5**
items.summary_md: It uses the dynarmic recompiler, and *Subway Surfers*, *Sonic Dash*, *Shadow Fight 2* and *Jetpack Joyride* are already playable.

items.headline_md: **COGBox** puts the classic **Xbox 360** *Gears of War* games on PC via static recompilation
items.summary_md: It’s a native Windows build with a Direct3D 12 renderer and you must supply your own copies and title updates; all four games are covered, with Gears 1 a lower priority.

items.headline_md: Recomp tracker: **287** releases this week, including **Perfect Dark XBLA** and **Mario Party** ports
items.summary_md: Nov 6 entries include Perfect Dark XBLA PC Recomp v0.9.1, Mario Party: Recompiled v0.2.9 and Mario Party 2: Recompiled v0.2.11; Demon’s Souls Recomp v2026.11.04 landed Nov 5.

sections.title: Movies
sections.body_md: Last weekend’s numbers ran in yesterday’s brief; this weekend’s actuals post Sunday.

items.headline_md: **Godzilla Minus Zero** takes ~**$6M** in previews, a record for distributor **GKIDS**
items.summary_md: Deadline’s early read says it could top the $30M+ industry forecast; Boxoffice Pro’s range is $25–35M for Nov 6–8. Rotten Tomatoes shows 90% critics and 96% audience.

items.headline_md: **The Cat in the Hat** opens soft: ~**$1M** previews, **$15–20M** weekend forecast
items.summary_md: Early reviews are lukewarm and tracking slid through release week, per Boxoffice Pro; it’s a $86M net production.

items.headline_md: **Drummer Boy** eyed at **$10–15M**; **You Can See Everything** may keep holding
items.summary_md: Angel Studios’ musical Revolutionary War drama is forecast as the studio’s best performer since *Young Washington*.

items.headline_md: **Imax** books record Q3: **$175M** revenue (+64%) on *The Odyssey*
items.summary_md: The film grossed over $550M on Imax screens in the quarter and about $1.8B worldwide; Imax now expects to beat its $1.4B 2026 projection.

items.headline_md: **Cameron Diaz** Netflix comedy **Bad Day** gets a trailer, arrives Dec 11
items.summary_md: She plays a single mom who accidentally robs a bank.

items.headline_md: Update: **OpenAI** launches **GPT-6 Cyber**, rated “Critical” for cyber capability
items.summary_md: Access is restricted via Daybreak Red; it scored 48.5% on ExploitGym versus 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber and costs $20 / $100 per million input / output tokens.

items.headline_md: **METR** says **Anthropic**’s AI progress is running ~**2x** faster, but key evidence is redacted
items.summary_md: The Nov 5 report covers Aug 12–Oct 29 and credits AI tools helping staff; Anthropic cited confidentiality for the redactions.

items.headline_md: **Claude** Personal Finance beta connects read-only to bank accounts
items.summary_md: US Pro, Max and Ultra users link accounts through Plaid; it can’t move money and reviews up to two years of transactions.

items.headline_md: **DOJ** launches a Super Intelligence Task Force
items.summary_md: It targets unlawful AI use by foreign governments and criminals, plus AI-related fraud.

items.headline_md: **Google** ships **Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash** video, 15-second clips at **$0.07/sec**
items.summary_md: Pricing for 720p video is cut 30% and it supports iterative edits through follow-up prompts.

items.headline_md: **Apple** opens **Siri AI** to all third-party developers in the **iOS 27.3** beta
items.summary_md: Apps expose actions through App Intents and can add “app skills” for multi-step workflows; App Store submissions for these open in spring.

items.headline_md: **Google** makes **Gemini** and **Search** opt-in for K–12 school accounts after backlash
items.summary_md: Schools can keep Search without Gemini, but AI Mode and AI Overviews stay; there’s no AI-free Search option.

items.headline_md: **Meta** lets US users video chat with their **Muse** AI avatar
items.summary_md: The avatar answers with facial expressions and gestures, supports interruptions and offers hundreds of voices.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: _Quote times are AZ. US jobs report is due 6:30 AM AZ._

items.summary_md: Dow 51,523.06, S&P 500 7,353.73 and Nasdaq 24,315.00 were each the worst day since April 2025; the Nasdaq is in correction, with Nvidia and Qualcomm down over 9%.
Chip stocks are bouncing after the rout while the jobs report caps gains; VIX closed Thursday at 28.2.

items.headline_md: Asia routs: **Nikkei ~−6%**, **Kospi ~−6.7%**, **Taiex −4.5%**
items.summary_md: Fri morning, per the Guardian’s live blog (~4:59 AM AZ); the FTSE 100 was down about 1.75% at one point.
Brent −1.38% and WTI $89.17 at 1:38 AM AZ (down from above $110 Monday); spot gold −0.6% at 7:48 PM AZ Thu; Bitcoin −6.2% in 24h at about 9:45 PM AZ Thu.

items.headline_md: **Phoenix**: high **78°F**, low **57°F** (overnight), sunny
items.summary_md: Chance of precipitation 0–9% through the day (0.00 in expected); no active alerts.

items.summary_md: Rain showers from ~8 AM then thunderstorms likely, 70% chance, about 0.07 in expected and no snow; no active alerts.

items.summary_md: Rain showers from ~8 AM then thunderstorms likely, 70% chance, about 0.05 in expected and no snow; no active alerts.
